Persistent Systems Stock Falls After Nagarro Acquisition Deal

Persistent Systems, an Indian IT company, has seen its stock price drop by over 6% after announcing a deal to acquire German software firm Nagarro SE for $1.14 billion. The acquisition is expected to create a new AI engineering giant. The move is seen as a significant development in the Indian tech industry and its global expansion plans.
